definitions.name: U1A.RLE
definitions.body: G0D.RUNS [ 'R' BIND R 0 GET R LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
definitions.note: numeric Vector -> Vector of [ value count ] pairs, one per maximal run of equal adjacent values

definitions.name: U1A.MAXOF
definitions.body: 'MV' BIND MV 0 GET MV [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of numbers or Strings -> its largest element

definitions.name: U1A.MISS01
definitions.note: Vector with NIL lanes -> same-length Vector of 1 where the lane is NIL, 0 where present

definitions.name: U1A.ARGMAXKEY
definitions.body: 'Q' BIND Q KEYS Q VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
definitions.note: Record of numbers -> the key with the largest value, the earliest key on ties

definitions.name: U1A.PRICE0
definitions.body: 'price' GET 'Q' BIND 0 Q Q NIL? SELECT
definitions.note: order Record -> its price, or 0 when it has none

definitions.name: U1A.LINE
definitions.body: 'R' BIND R 'qty' GET R U1A.PRICE0 MUL
definitions.note: order Record -> qty times price (0 when unpriced)

definitions.name: U1A.REVENUE
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> total qty*price over priced orders

definitions.name: U1A.QTYREC
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS 'O' BIND O [ 'sku' GET ] MAP O [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Record sku -> summed qty, skus in first-appearance order

definitions.name: U1A.TITLEWORD
definitions.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty word -> first letter upper case, rest lower case
